title: Introductory Latin
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences

title: Continuing Latin
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed LATN1001: Introductory Latin or have gained the permission of the convenor based on prior Latin study.

title: Intermediate Latin
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed LATN2119: Continuing Latin or have gained the permission of the convenor based on prior Latin study.

title: Advanced Latin
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed either LATN2121: Intermediate Latin at ANU or Year 12 Latin (or its equivalent).
